# Building Resilient Systems in the AI & Cloud Era

> A free online book on production engineering — SLOs, performance and capacity, Kubernetes and GitOps, shipping change safely, designing for failure, data and disaster recovery, security operations, operating AI workloads, and production readiness. 9 chapters, one running example (Encore, a concert-ticketing company), a kata per chapter. Book 4 of the AI & Cloud Era series; followed by "Operating Production Systems" (the Operations book).

- [Full book, single page](https://oleksiyp.github.io/resilienteng-book/)
- [Full book as raw markdown](https://oleksiyp.github.io/resilienteng-book/llms-full.txt)
- Per-chapter pages: https://oleksiyp.github.io/resilienteng-book/ch/1/ through /ch/9/
- Architecture book: [Software Architecture in the AI & Cloud Era](https://oleksiyp.github.io/arch-book/)
